title: GTA 6 Gameplay Reveal Pulls 3.97M Peak Viewers
description: Grand Theft Auto 6's first gameplay presentation reaction streams reached a staggering 3.97 million peak viewers, overwhelming Twitch and Netflix in the process.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## GTA 6 Gameplay Reveal Shatters Streaming Records with 3.97 Million Viewers

The anticipation surrounding Rockstar Games' upcoming blockbuster reached a fever pitch as reaction streams for Grand Theft Auto 6's first gameplay presentation pulled in a staggering 3,970,738 peak viewers across various livestreaming platforms, according to reports by Eurogamer.

This monumental milestone officially cements the event as the biggest gaming stream of 2026 so far. The sheer volume of concurrent viewers tuned into the gameplay reveal caused massive surges across the digital ecosystem, effectively overwhelming both Twitch and Netflix in the process as fans rushed to witness the latest footage from the streets of Vice City and beyond.

## A Phenomenal Milestone for the Gaming Industry

Securing nearly 4 million peak viewers is a rare feat in the modern streaming landscape, demonstrating the unparalleled cultural footprint of the Grand Theft Auto franchise. As players and content creators dissected every second of the presentation, platforms buckled under the immense traffic weight, highlighting the unprecedented level of consumer interest driving GTA 6 toward its eventual launch.

While this massive viewer turnout is a testament to the game's staggering global appeal, it also sets a remarkably high benchmark for gaming broadcasts throughout the rest of 2026.

## Editor's Take

GTA 6 continues to operate in a league of its own. Pulling nearly 4 million peak viewers for a gameplay reaction stream isn't just a win for the streaming platforms; it's a clear indicator that the hype train for Rockstar's next masterpiece is entirely unstoppable. When a single gameplay presentation can shake the foundations of major tech services like Twitch and Netflix, you know you are witnessing history in the making.
